game_identity.player_fantasy: Be the last maintenance runner carrying unstable charge from a central core to failing relays fast enough to keep the network alive.
game_identity.central_interaction: Route, recharge, carry, and transfer charge between a central core and four decaying relay beacons.

playable_loop: Move -> recharge at core -> choose upper/lower passage -> carry charge -> read changing relay urgency -> choose which relay to service -> touch beacon to transfer -> manage decay -> stabilize all four or black out -> retry
technology_stack: Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript Canvas; local/offline browser; no dependencies
current_milestone: Stateful Relay Triage Slice: prove that live relay state, not only static route geometry, can create a meaningful choice about which relay to rescue next. On one exact accepted composition, show at least two plausible relay choices from a meaningful run snapshot with materially different urgency, measure different network consequences for those choices, visually expose enough relay state to inspect that urgency without hidden debug data, and preserve WON / ordinary BLACKOUT / retry / completion precedence plus the accepted route-shaped chamber. Prefer evidence on the existing independent-decay model before adding new relay types, hazards, resources, or primary verbs. Human/fresh-player PLAYTESTED evidence remains required before claims about intuitive triage, fairness, tension, balance, or fun.

evidence_status.triage_slice: PARTIAL / CONSEQUENCE PROVEN ON ACCEPTED RULES. QA PR #27 is accepted main evidence: a naturally reached 31.20s snapshot at the centered core had runner charge 100% and relay energies R1 28.36, R2 53.71, R3 0.00, R4 56.15.
